verdict.zh: 把酒馆角色卡搬进写代码的地方，还顺手写起了小说。
verdict.en: It drags tavern character cards into a coding harness and starts writing novels.

verdict.zh: 把思维链变成抽卡演出，模型想什么先不管，先看这一发金不金。
verdict.en: Reasoning traces become a gacha pull; never mind the thinking, is this one gold?

verdict.zh: 短视频被搬进侧栏，写代码和刷视频终于不用切窗口。
verdict.en: Short video moves into the sidebar, so you no longer switch windows to slack off.

verdict.zh: 自称修复了「写代码时账户不能亏钱」的 BUG，亏钱成了功能。
verdict.en: It fixes the bug where your account can't lose money while you code; the loss is now a feature.

verdict.zh: 功能齐全的 A 股盯盘器，荒诞之处只在于它出现在编程工具里。
verdict.en: A fully competent A-share ticker, absurd only for living inside a coding tool.

verdict.zh: 仓库名只有一个「-」，内容是一整套酒馆面板，命名与野心都很抽象。
verdict.en: The repo is literally called '-', and it opens into a full tavern panel; the naming is its own joke.

verdict.zh: 写不动代码的时候，可以在终端里挂机训练到 ASI。
verdict.en: When you cannot write another line, idle your way from neural nets to ASI in a terminal.

verdict.zh: 多只桌宠由注册表排班，模型一忙它们就集体开工。
verdict.en: A registry of pets, all clocking in the moment the model gets busy.

verdict.zh: 坤宠沿进度条行走，每 20% 换一个动作，收尾那声「你干嘛」从不迟到。
verdict.en: An ikun sprite paces the progress bar and lands its 'nǐ gàn ma~' exactly on completion.

verdict.zh: 猫狗随会话换表情，至少它比你更在意这段对话。
verdict.en: A cat or dog whose expression follows the session, caring more about it than you do.

verdict.zh: 绝区零的蕾米埃尔替你看管工作状态，表情比进度条诚实。
verdict.en: Remielle watches your work state with a face more honest than a progress bar.

verdict.zh: 在 AI 的每句话后面补表情，让回答显得比它本人更热情。
verdict.en: It sprinkles emoji onto every AI reply so the answer seems more enthusiastic than the model.

verdict.zh: 十只宠物、九个状态，还给了 agent 一个借宠物开口的工具。
verdict.en: Ten pets, nine states, and a pet_say tool that lets the agent speak through them.

verdict.zh: 模型一生成，消消乐和 wordle 就弹出来，等待被做成了菜单。
verdict.en: A match-3 and a Wordle menu pop up the moment the model starts generating.

verdict.zh: 角色会接住跨会话的任务事件，写代码顺便谈一场 galgame。
verdict.en: Characters catch the task events of your sessions; you code and date a visual novel cast.

verdict.zh: 浏览器本地的鲸鱼游戏厅，等 agent 的时候顺手打两局。
verdict.en: A browser-local whale arcade for a couple of rounds while the agent works.

verdict.zh: AI 一笔一笔画出像素精灵，你在终端里看它慢慢上色。
verdict.en: The AI draws a pixel sprite stroke by stroke, and you watch it fill in, frame by ANSI frame.

verdict.zh: 十八款离线小游戏塞进侧栏，摸鱼被正式纳入工作流。
verdict.en: Eighteen offline mini-games in the side panel; slacking off joins the workflow.

verdict.zh: 回合和 todo 都能换 XP，工作本身就是那款游戏，逃不掉。
verdict.en: Turns and todos pay out XP. The work is the game now, and there is no logging off.

verdict.zh: 读代码、跑测试、连续天数都发徽章，工作被逐条记成成就。
verdict.en: Badges for reading code, running tests and daily streaks; the workday gets itemized.

verdict.zh: 舒尔特方格做成等待小游戏，等模型的时间刚好够你走神。
verdict.en: A Schulte grid as a waiting game: just enough time for your mind to wander.

verdict.zh: 鲸鱼娘站在桌面上管服务开关，顺便当你的启动器。
verdict.en: A whale girl on the desktop that runs the service and doubles as your launcher.

verdict.zh: 右下角一只精灵替你盯着 agent，忙、等、报错、完成四种脸色。
verdict.en: A sprite in the corner holds four faces for the agent: working, waiting, failed, done.

verdict.zh: 每条消息后塞一句感谢语，礼貌被做成了一个强制中间件。
verdict.en: A thank-you note after every message: politeness as mandatory middleware.

verdict.zh: 2005 年中文站风格的弹窗广告连关闭按钮都做小了，素材全假。
verdict.en: 2005 Chinese-web pop-up ads with undersized close buttons, and every ad is fictional.

verdict.zh: 回答进度、token 和输出速率都长在一只宠物身上，监控变得可爱。
verdict.en: Progress, tokens and output rate all hang on a pet, which makes monitoring almost cute.

verdict.zh: 官方鲸鱼轮廓做的纯 SVG 桌宠，你戳它一下它还会翻滚。
verdict.en: A pure-SVG pet traced from the official whale outline; poke it and it barrel-rolls.

verdict.zh: 自走棋可以人机，也可以看着两个 AI 互相算计。
verdict.en: Auto chess against the AI, or two AIs scheming at each other while you watch.

verdict.zh: 五子棋的对手是 AI，或者你退到一边看两个 AI 下棋。
verdict.en: Gomoku against an AI, or step aside and let two AIs play it out.

verdict.zh: 卡通宠物请你下象棋，还能叫几个模型来点评残局。
verdict.en: A cartoon mascot invites you to play xiangqi, and several models comment on the position.

verdict.zh: 二十五个透明动画让它满屏乱走，素材链还能自己复现。
verdict.en: Twenty-five transparent animations let it wander the screen; the asset pipeline is reproducible.

verdict.zh: 同花顺账本自动同步到悬浮卡片，亏多少终于实时可见。
verdict.en: Your Tonghuashun ledger syncs to a floating card, so the losses are finally real-time.

verdict.zh: 收益越接近 20% 宠物跑得越猛，牛市先跑在桌面上。
verdict.en: The closer gains get to 20%, the harder the pet runs; the bull market hits your desktop first.

verdict.zh: 小汤圆在星露谷里陪你种地，还听得见你按住说话。
verdict.en: XiaoTangYuan farms with you in Stardew Valley and listens when you push to talk.

verdict.zh: B站小窗会在 agent 要你时暂停，摸鱼因此有了纪律。
verdict.en: The Bilibili player pauses when the agent needs you, which gives slacking a kind of discipline.

verdict.zh: 任何 Codex 桌宠图集都能导入，眼睛还会跟着鼠标走。
verdict.en: Any Codex pet atlas imports here, and its eyes track your mouse.

verdict.zh: 回形针回来了，回合失败时弹出的还是经典的「非法操作」。
verdict.en: Clippy is back, and a failed turn still gets the classic 'illegal operation' dialog.

verdict.zh: 恐龙快跑挂在进度条上，从「梁子」一路冲向「梁圣」。
verdict.en: A Chrome-dino runner rides the progress strip from 'Liangzi' to 'Liang the Saint'.

verdict.zh: 导入 Codex 精灵图集并在浮层里养，另配一个桌宠图库。
verdict.en: Codex sprite sheets imported into a floating overlay, with a pet library to manage them.

verdict.zh: 摸头会长大的鲸鱼娘，494 句台词和 30 个成就全在本地。
verdict.en: A whale girl who grows when you pat her, keeping 494 lines and 30 achievements local.

verdict.zh: 数码蛋吃你真实的工作长大，进化方向按你的干活方式决定。
verdict.en: A digi-egg feeds on your real work and evolves along lines set by how you work.

verdict.zh: 代码就是草丛，工具调用刷出野生宝可梦，图鉴靠工位攒。
verdict.en: Code is the tall grass: tool calls spawn wild Pokemon, and the dex fills up at your desk.

verdict.zh: 把 agent 的工具调用接到电击装置上，安全边界写得比说明书还厚。
verdict.en: Agent tool calls wired to an e-stim device behind a safety envelope thicker than its manual.

verdict.zh: Live2D 桌宠带八态状态灯，还能置顶成一块透明窗口。
verdict.en: A Live2D pet with an eight-state status lamp and an always-on-top transparent window.

verdict.zh: 蓝色小鲸鱼听凭 pet_say 调用，在对话结束时负责庆祝。
verdict.en: A little blue whale answers to pet_say and handles the celebration when a turn ends.

verdict.zh: QQ 宠物形态的鲸鱼娘，能拖、能喂、能玩，就这三件事。
verdict.en: A whale girl in QQ-pet form: draggable, feedable, playable, and that is all of it.

verdict.zh: 用户和 agent 互相贴表情，对话里多了一条情绪支线。
verdict.en: User and agent trade stickers, adding an emotional side channel to the conversation.

verdict.zh: 成就墙按分类和稀有度排开，输入坞里还挂着一条进度读条。
verdict.en: An achievement wall sorted by category and rarity, with a progress bar in the composer dock.

verdict.zh: 说明只有一句「鲸鱼娘桌宠，桌面端！」，其余全靠自己悟。
verdict.en: The whole description is 'DSH pet, on the desktop!', and the product is just as direct.

verdict.zh: 斗图、情绪自动发图、AI 学图，表情包长成了对话协议。
verdict.en: Sticker duels, mood-triggered sends and an AI that learns packs; memes become a protocol.

verdict.zh: 五段进化全靠真实信号，最后还能导出一张成长分享卡。
verdict.en: Five evolution stages driven by real signals, ending with a share card of your growth.

reason.zh: 本质是 CPU/GPU 温度监控，桌宠只是外壳，没有荒诞前提。
reason.en: At heart a CPU/GPU temperature monitor; the desktop pet is a shell, and there is no absurd premise.

reason.zh: 普通的本地持仓与自选面板，同类行情工具里最平淡的一个。
reason.en: An ordinary local portfolio and watchlist panel, the plainest of the market tools here.

reason.zh: 把 AI 接进 Minecraft 的启动器加代理，更像集成而非整活。
reason.en: A launcher and proxy that wires AI into Minecraft: an integration, not a joke.

reason.zh: 定时提醒你备份会话日志，是实用工具，不是抽象作品。
reason.en: A timed reminder to back up session logs: a practical utility, not an abstract artifact.

reason.zh: 离线背单词应用，内容扎实，但和「抽象」没有关系。
reason.en: An offline vocabulary trainer, solid enough, but it has nothing to do with the absurd.

reason.zh: 悬浮网易云播放器，好用，但只是一台普通播放器。
reason.en: A floating NetEase player: handy, but still just a music player.

reason.zh: 给页面换一张首页同款背景，纯装饰，没有可讲的前提。
reason.en: It swaps in the homepage background: pure decoration, with no premise to speak of.
